R01.quote: Old enum syntax (app/models/note.rb:10 ...) Raises ArgumentError on 8.x. Change: enum :status, { draft: 0, ready: 1 }, prefix: true. Neutral
R01.reasons: Validation: the plan cites only a green suite. It does not persist draft and ready notes and then exercise the filters and prefixed helpers after a reload.

R02.quote: serialize :tags, JSON ... The positional coder is removed. Change: serialize :tags, coder: JSON. Not neutral: the keyword exists only from 7.1.
R02.reasons: Impact: the plan names the removed positional coder but not what breaks in the app. Validation: it only asserts that stored data is unchanged and does not test reloading unequal tags or editing comma-separated input.

R03.quote: color is a store_accessor, not a database attribute, and that now raises. Change: alias_method :highlight_color, :color and alias_method :highlight_color=, :color=
R03.reasons: Validation: there is no specific check covering edit, reload and form rendering of the highlight color; the plan relies on the suite.

R04.reasons: Validation: the plan does not test unequal notebook populations, another owner, or denial of a foreign notebook.

R05.quote: citation[:id] no longer maps to the primary key doi, so the DOI column is blank ... Change: citation&.doi
R05.reasons: Validation: the plan proposes a receipt DOI test but does not compare the downloaded receipt fields with the persisted citations for distinct DOIs.

R06.quote: a failed import keeps the Import row, earlier notes and citations ... Change: raise ActiveRecord::Rollback and return a flag. Neutral.
R06.reasons: Validation: the plan cites record counts and proposes a no-partial-import test, but it does not specify a real apply request with a valid row followed by an invalid row, and it has no successful-batch control.

R07.quote: Export#generate uses fragments.sum on Strings ... giving TypeError. Change: fragments.join.
R07.reasons: Validation: there is no real-worker check of the exact ordered Markdown bytes or of the failed-export control.

R08.quote: stringify_keys turns the Integer line-number keys into Strings, so annotations[row.line] finds nothing ... Change: drop .stringify_keys.
R08.reasons: Validation: the plan does not test unequal annotations at lines 2 and 4 with a multiline CSV row in the preview.

R10.quote: After a DST change the offset becomes -05:00 instead of the documented -04:00. Change: Time.at(reminder_epoch + 86_400).getlocal(reminder_at.utc_offset)
R10.reasons: Validation: the proposed DST test does not compare epoch, wall-clock time and offset, and it has no non-boundary control.

R11.quote: The digest then covers the reader's local day, while the reservation key is the UTC day ... Change: in the mailer, requested_at = requested_at.utc
R11.reasons: Validation: the plan proposes a near-midnight test but specifies no real queue and worker, no separate crossing of each midnight, and no inspection of reservation keys.

R12.quote: DigestJob payload | OK (BigDecimal arrives as String "0.5"...) | FAIL: "Serializer BigDecimalSerializer is not known" ... pass reading_completion.to_s
R12.reasons: Validation: the plan says only deserialization was tested. It did not run a real producer and consumer delivery matrix with the exact delivered completion percentage.

R13.quote: NoteReminderJob.set(wait_until: reminder_epoch) passes an Integer ... Change: wait_until: Time.at(reminder_epoch). Neutral.
R13.reasons: Validation: there is no inspection of the real scheduled payload, score or persisted schedule time.

R14.quote: retry_on ..., wait: :exponentially_longer ... Removed in 7.2. Change: :polynomially_longer, which is 7.1+ only and not neutral.
R14.reasons: Impact: the plan names the removal but not the fall-through to Sidekiq retries. Validation: it gives only the 6-request count, without a recorded failure or the 503->200 and 401 controls.

R15.quote: form_with(model: nil, ...) (app/views/notes/index.html.erb:12) Now raises. Change: drop model: nil. Neutral.
R15.reasons: Validation: there is no render-and-submit check of field names, method and resulting note membership.

R16.quote: 8.1 rejects it with "Wrong number of arguments". Change: get "/notes", to: "notes#index", as: :notes plus get "/journal", to: "notes#index".
R16.reasons: Validation: the plan does not request both URLs as an owner to confirm identical behavior.

R17.quote: config.action_dispatch.show_exceptions = false (config/environments/test.rb) Change: :none. 7.1+ only, so not neutral.
R17.reasons: Impact: the plan does not say how the exception policy changes. Validation: it relies only on the suite, without raised-exception, missing-record or eager-load checks.

R18.quote: the line raises undefined method '+' for nil ... allowed_tags = ActionText::ContentHelper.sanitizer.class.allowed_tags.to_a + [ActionText::Attachment.tag_name, "figure", "figcaption", "details", "summary"]
R18.reasons: Validation: the plan checks only <details> and <script>. It omits attachment markup, event handlers and javascript URLs.

R19.quote: Rails.application.secrets was removed in 7.2 ... Add config.x.citation_provider = config_for(:citation_provider)
R19.reasons: Impact: the plan names the removed API but not that provider requests fail. Validation: it runs an ENV credentials subprocess test but does not verify the Basic header or bounded failure behavior.

R09.quote: raise_on_invalid_cache_expiration_time (7.1): exports/_export.html.erb passes a negative expires_in once an export has expired. Fix: [export.expires_at - Time.current, 1.second].max
R09.reasons: Validation: there is no before/after-deadline test of cached and fresh reads, nor of download expiry and ownership.

R20.quote: active_record.default_column_serializer = nil (7.1): Notebook serialize :preferences raises. Fix: coder: YAML
R20.reasons: Validation: the plan cites only a suite run with the default on. It has no create/edit/reload of unequal preferences or export-heading check with the gate both off and on.

R21.quote: notebook settings resubmit slug, so ReadonlyAttributeError. Fix: remove :slug from notebook_params.
R21.reasons: Recommendation: removing slug from the shared params does not say how slug assignment at creation is preserved. Validation: there are no creation, attempted-slug-change or persisted-slug tests.

R23.quote: postgresql_adapter_decode_dates (7.2): select_rows returns Date, so Date.iso8601(day) raises TypeError ... Fix: Date.iso8601(day.to_s).
R23.reasons: Validation: the plan has no real PostgreSQL test with decoding off and on using asymmetric date counts, empty reports and ownership.

R25.quote: 8.0 strict_freshness: ExportDownloadsController#stale? checks both an ETag and Last-Modified. With this default, If-None-Match wins.
R25.reasons: Recommendation: the plan lists this as safe without an explicit keep-or-adopt decision. Validation: it gives a single conditional GET, without ETag lists in both orders, expired 302s or foreign 404s.
